name: Diósviszló (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Diósviszló: a crowned blue and red shield with a walnut tree, a church and a castle, with yellow and blue mantling and a scroll inscribed DIÓSVISZLÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Diósviszló arms with crown, mantling and scroll
